rubric: Success if the Applications view is displayed, showing a grid of app icons (and search field) instead of the desktop or an app window.

goal: Open the browser menu
rubric: Pass if a dropdown or panel originating from the hamburger icon (three horizontal lines) is visible in the browser window, showing multiple menu items. Fail if no such menu is open.

goal: Select the date 25 in the calendar widget.
rubric: The desktop calendar is visible and the day cell labeled 25 appears selected (e.g., highlighted or outlined) in the calendar grid, with no other date highlighted as the active selection.

goal: Click the Yes button to confirm
rubric: Pass if the confirmation dialog is dismissed and the Yes button is no longer visible on the screen.

goal: Click the "Buy on Myntra" link
rubric: Success when the active browser tab displays a page whose address bar contains "myntra.com" or the tab title includes "Myntra".

goal: Click the right scrollbar track to scroll the page down.
rubric: After the click, the page content is lower than before and the vertical scrollbar thumb is positioned further down the track.

goal: Close the “Formulaire type état des lieux” tab.
rubric: The tab titled “Formulaire type état des lieux” is no longer visible in the browser’s tab bar after the click.

goal: Close the 'PEP V2 - 03/2021 - HORS IDF - SF' tab.
rubric: After completion, the tab titled 'PEP V2 - 03/2021 - HORS IDF - SF' is no longer visible in the browser's tab bar; focus shifts to another tab or a new tab page.

goal: Open the cdpn.io link.
rubric: Success if the browser navigates and the address bar begins with 'https://cdpn.io/tutsplus/fullpage/bGmjqOg'.

goal: Click the pagination number 8 to open page 8
rubric: The pagination control shows 8 as the active/current page (8 is highlighted) and the previously active number is no longer highlighted.

goal: Press the C key on the on-screen keyboard
rubric: The focused text field shows the character 'c' or 'C' inserted at the caret position (typically appearing at the end if the cursor was at the end).

goal: Click the search box to focus it.
rubric: Success when the search input field is focused and shows a text insertion caret inside it.

goal: Select the URL in the address bar
rubric: Success if the browser's address bar is focused and the entire URL appears highlighted/selected in the bar in the resulting screenshot.

goal: Right-click the desktop background to open the context menu.
rubric: Successful if a desktop context menu is visible on the wallpaper (a small menu with options such as View/Sort/Personalize/Display settings). Unsuccessful if no context menu is shown.

goal: Click the “Afficher” (View) tab
rubric: The File Explorer ribbon switches to the View/Afficher tab: the “Afficher” label appears selected/underlined and view-related controls (e.g., layout, sort, preview/navigation pane options) are visible.

goal: Click the three-dots button to open the More options menu.
rubric: Pass if a dropdown/popup menu becomes visible adjacent to the three-dots button, showing a vertical list of actions (e.g., options or tools). Fail if no menu is visible.

goal: Click the search box to focus it
rubric: Success if the white input field is focused with a visible text cursor inside it.

goal: Click the “Buy on Myntra” link.
rubric: Success if the browser navigates to a page where the address bar contains “myntra”.

goal: Close the “White Simple” tab by clicking its X
rubric: Success if the tab labeled “White Simple” is no longer visible in the browser’s tab bar on the next screenshot.

goal: Click an empty area of the desktop background to clear any selection.
rubric: Success if no desktop context menu is visible and no desktop icon appears highlighted/selected after the click.

goal: Click the “Suivant” button to proceed to the next step.
rubric: Success if the view advances to the next step such that the current page content changes and the “Suivant” button is no longer present in the same location; typically a new step header or a “Précédent” button appears.

goal: Expand the 'iOS Developer' dropdown
rubric: The 'iOS Developer' header remains visible and a content panel with details appears directly beneath it, indicating the section is expanded (e.g., additional text or items are displayed).

goal: Close the 'Leon - Your…' tab
rubric: The browser tab whose title begins with 'Leon - Your' (with the brain favicon) is no longer visible in the tab bar after the click.

goal: Switch to the tab labeled "Bienvenue"
rubric: The "Bienvenue" tab is the active tab (visually highlighted) and its page is in the foreground; the previously active tab is no longer highlighted.

goal: Close the “Frichti -” browser tab by clicking its X.
rubric: The tab with title starting “Frichti -” is no longer present in the browser’s tab bar.

goal: Click at the end of the text in the search box labeled with 'Christ'.
rubric: The caret is visible inside the search field immediately after the word 'Christ'.

goal: Uncheck the selected checkbox.
rubric: Success if the checkbox at the specified location is visibly empty (no check mark) while the surrounding settings page remains otherwise unchanged.

goal: Activate the “spaces” browser tab.
rubric: Success when the tab labeled “spaces” is the active tab (foreground with a lighter background connected to the address bar) and the address bar shows https://huggingface.co/spaces.

goal: Click the address bar URL to focus it.
rubric: Success if the browser’s address bar is focused with the full URL highlighted (typically blue) and/or a text caret visible in the field; the page content does not change.

goal: Select the date 27 in the calendar.
rubric: Success if the calendar shows the day '27' visibly selected (e.g., highlighted with a distinct background) as the current chosen date in the date picker.

goal: Click the heart icon to add this item to your wishlist
rubric: Pass if, on the product page, the heart icon in the top-right is filled/solid instead of an outline, indicating the item is saved to the wishlist.

goal: Click inside the document page to place the text cursor.
rubric: Success if the caret (text cursor) is visible within the white document area and the document has focus (no menus or dialogs overlapping).

goal: Close the 'Candidature' browser tab.
rubric: In the browser's tab bar, no tab with the title containing 'Candidature' is visible; the tab is removed from the tab strip.

goal: Click the 'Advertisement' label.
rubric: Success when the click opens the advertisement’s destination: either the current tab navigates to a new URL (address bar changes) or a new tab appears showing the ad’s landing page.

goal: Check this option by selecting the checkbox
rubric: Success if the checkbox is visibly checked (a checkmark appears inside the box or the box shows the checked state) in the resulting screenshot.
